ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (31) has a matching target block; 3 page marker(s) preserved in place; 8 numbered section(s); attributions: Lucy Mallory, A reasonable person loves not because it is profitable to him, but because he finds good in love itself, Persian wisdom, Amiel, Crosby, Metta Sutta.

Attributions follow the print (Crosby, not an expanded name). «Наука» (nauka) in the Chinese sage's question is 'learning'; «владыка» (vladyka) is 'sovereign', kept twice; «нелюбовь» (nelyubov') is rendered 'lack of love'.
